title: Account
signInIntro: Sign in to keep a history of your certificates, sync rule profiles across devices and manage API keys. The free validator stays free — no account needed to use it.
signedInHint: Your models never leave the browser — the account only stores results you choose to keep.

plan.title: Plan
plan.pastDue: Your last payment failed — Pro stays active for 14 days while you update your card.

billing.notYet: Payments aren't enabled yet — Pro is coming soon.

keys.title: API keys
keys.hint: For the upcoming verify-batch API. The key is shown only once — store it somewhere safe.
keys.createdOnce: Key created — copy it now, it will never be shown again.
keys.quota: Your plan's API key limit is reached — revoke one or upgrade.
keys.disabled: The API service is not configured.

upsell.title: This is a Pro feature
upsell.freeStays: Everything you use today stays free — Pro adds server-side value on top.

sync.title: In my account
sync.signInPrompt: Sign in to save this and sync it across your devices.
sync.upsell: Syncing rule profiles across devices is a Pro feature.
sync.readOnly: Your plan ended — your saved profiles are read-only. You can still open and download them.
sync.readOnlyNote: Read-only: your plan ended. Open or download your profiles; upgrade to save changes.
sync.nothingToSave: Give it a name first, then save.

history.title: My certificates
history.hint: Certificates you issue while signed in are saved here. Anonymous issuance is never stored.
history.empty: No certificates yet — issue one from the export dialog while signed in.

checkoutWelcome: Welcome to Pro! Your account is active.
checkoutPending: We're still confirming your payment — it can take a minute. Your plan will activate automatically.

errors.generic: Something went wrong — please try again.

branding.title: Certificate branding
branding.hint: Your logo appears in the header of every certificate you issue while signed in — on screen and in print.
branding.empty: No logo yet — PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {{kb}} KB.
branding.tooBig: The image must be {{kb}} KB or less.
branding.badType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
branding.needsPro: Branding needs an active Pro plan.

welcome: Welcome! You are signed in — your certificates and profiles now sync to your account.

welcomePage.title: Your account is ready
welcomePage.subtitle: The free validator stays free — your account adds the layer that lives across sessions and devices.
welcomePage.historyBody: Every certificate you issue while signed in is kept with its verification link.
welcomePage.syncBody: Rule profiles, IDS specs and EIR profiles follow you to any device.
welcomePage.brandBody: Put your logo on the printable certificate your clients see.
welcomePage.cta: Open a model and start validating
welcomePage.hint: Your account lives behind the Account button in the viewer toolbar.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your certificates, keys and branding — all in one place.
dashboard.signInBody: See your certificate history, manage API keys and add your branding. The free validator stays free — an account only stores what you choose to keep.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.denied: This area is reserved for platform administrators.
admin.offline: The platform API is not reachable from this build (VITE_API_URL missing or network error).
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete {{id}} permanently? Personal data is removed (GDPR cascade); evidentiary records survive anonymised. This cannot be undone.
admin.limitsPrompt: Limit overrides as JSON (e.g. {"api_keys": 10}). Empty = remove overrides.
admin.limitsInvalid: That is not a valid {"key": number} JSON object.
admin.resetConfirm: Reset this workspace's current-month usage counters to zero?
admin.searchUsers: Search by user id, plan or org…
admin.identityNote: Identity lookups are resolved via Clerk and logged in the audit trail (GDPR accountability).
admin.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {{id}} from this organization? The membership row is kept (soft-removed) for the audit trail.
admin.addMemberHint: The user must have signed in at least once.
admin.seatsPrompt: Number of seats for this organization:
admin.seatsInvalid: Seats must be a positive whole number.

authTitle: Your account keeps projects, certificates and billing together
authPoint1: The viewer and validator stay free, with no account
authPoint2: Files you open in the browser stay in the browser
authPoint3: Your files reach our servers only when you run a cloud feature

legacy.title: We have upgraded your account
legacy.body1: We are making changes to the product and improving the plans for registered users. Our roadmap is to give you a better service, and to do that we have moved accounts to a new production system.
legacy.body2: Your account and email have been kept. If you used to sign in with a password, sign in with Google or with the code we email you; you can set a new password from your profile if you like.
legacy.body3: Sorry for the trouble of signing in again even though you already had an account. Thank you for staying with us.
legacy.signInHint: Already had an account? We have moved to a new system and your account is kept: sign in with Google or with the code we email you. Your old password no longer works.

requests.entryHint: What would help you most? One tap is enough, and it decides what we build next.
requests.title: What would help you most?
requests.intro: Pick one and send: that is all it takes. I read every one myself (Joel), and it decides what we build next.

big_files.title: Open very large files
big_files.hint: Models over 400 MB that do not fit in the browser today

versions.title: Cloud projects with versions
versions.hint: See what changed when a new version is uploaded

client_link.title: Share with my client
client_link.hint: A link to the model and the report, nothing to install

bcf_team.title: BCF issues with my team
bcf_team.hint: Assign, statuses, due dates and saved views

auto_check.title: Check every delivery automatically
auto_check.hint: Against my company standard (IDS, EIR, naming)

cloud_drives.title: Open from Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox

batch_tools.title: Batch tools
batch_tools.hint: Edit, rename or split many IFC files at once

requests.needPlaceholder: E.g. I need it to send the model to the client every Friday
requests.needPlaceholderOther: Tell us what you are trying to do and where you get stuck
requests.frequencyLabel: How often does it come up?
requests.todayLabel: How do you handle it today?
requests.payerLabel: If it existed, who would pay for it?
requests.beta: I want to try it before anyone else (I will email you access)
requests.call: I can do a 15-minute video call
requests.contactOk: You can email me about this request.
requests.privacy: We store your answer with your account and email to understand it and, if you ask, write to you. We never publish or share it.
requests.thanksContact: I read it personally and will email you.
requests.thanksNoContact: I read it personally, and it counts towards what we build next.
requests.thanksStatus: Under “Your requests” you will see its status and my reply.

error.missing: Pick an option (for “Something else”, say what you need).
error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again and resend it.
error.need_too_short: Tell us in a few words what you need.
error.daily_limit: You have sent 5 requests today. You can send more tomorrow, or email hola@ifcvieweronline.eu.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a row. Please wait a minute.
error.unavailable: That did not work right now. Please try again in a moment.
error.network: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid: Check the form and try again.

requests.nudgeBody: One question, 10 seconds. What you tell us decides what we build next.
